first_half#fh_1h_ot_note.rationale: Sampled 1H text says 'in the 1st half' but carries a stray 'inclusive of overtime' note; only Kalshi can confirm the note is a template carry-over with no effect on 1H settlement.

futures_champion#fc_balance_hypothesis.catalog_action: Test balance as a predictor of tournament game outcomes after controlling for rating over 20+ tournaments; keep, reweight or drop the input on the result.

futures_champion#fc_conf_bucket_rules.rationale: KXMARMADCONFWIN gives no affiliation date or 'Other' definition and KXNCAAMBTOURNEY gives no cancelled-event rule; the published wording is silent and only Kalshi can supply it.

futures_champion#fc_coshare_payout.catalog_action: Record the Big Ten's published regular-season title/co-champion policy in the catalog and note BIG10REG payout as conditional on a future listing.

futures_champion#fc_drift_calibration.rationale: The Nov-to-Mar strength drift sd (2-3 pts) is stated without estimation; it can be measured from a results-only rating replica built on historical scores, stratified by returning minutes.
futures_champion#fc_drift_calibration.catalog_action: Estimate strength drift sd from weekly results-only ratings over 12 seasons (ESPN scores), stratified by returning-minutes share, and replace the asserted 2-3 pt figure.

futures_champion#fc_vacated_titles.rationale: No sampled championship rule addresses vacated or later-ineligible champions or a determination date; this tail is resolvable only by Kalshi's own terms or a ruling.

futures_champion#fc_womens_data.rationale: The women's title input is defined; stats.ncaa.org and Her Hoop Stats both refuse connections from this environment, so their coverage and history cannot be verified here.

futures_conference#fcf_bans_vacated.rationale: No conference series text covers postseason-banned teams, vacated results or cancelled tournaments; settlement depends on Kalshi rulebook provisions not in the sample.

futures_conference#fcf_strength_sd.catalog_action: Estimate strength sd by games played from 15 seasons of historical ratings and validate simulated co-champion frequencies against actual conference histories.
